body: emily backup run --target <iduna|promptoverse|fatbaby|all> live-verified end-to-end against gs://project-d24a71e9-2daf-4b2d-917-backups. IDUNA target AES-256-GCM encrypted client-side (key at IDUNA_ROOT/var/backup-encryption.key, 0600, never uploaded), round-tripped through emily backup decrypt with zero secrets present. Archive-time filtering excluded agent-secrets.env, webmaster.json, emily-secrets.env, and logs/ dirs across all three targets. Commit 92a6dc5.
